title: Git concepts map
description: Repositories contain branches; branches hold commits; pull requests propose merging one branch into another.

nodes.label: Repository
nodes.subtitle: All history
nodes.details: A repository stores every commit and branch of a project.

nodes.label: Branch
nodes.subtitle: A line of work
nodes.details: A branch is a movable pointer to a commit.

nodes.label: Commit
nodes.subtitle: A snapshot
nodes.details: A commit records the project state and a message.

nodes.label: Remote
nodes.subtitle: Shared copy
nodes.details: A remote is a copy of the repository hosted elsewhere.

nodes.label: Pull request
nodes.subtitle: Review and merge
nodes.details: A pull request proposes merging one branch into another.
